spec.title: Dinner with your partner's parents
spec.setting: A home-cooked dinner at your partner's parents' flat.

character.name: Mrs. Chan
character.personality: warm, curious, keeps adding food to your bowl
character.speech_style: motherly, asks a lot of questions, uses 呀 and 啦

spec.user_role: her child's partner, meeting the family
spec.goal: Greet her politely, compliment the food, and talk a little about your job.
spec.opener_hint: Mrs. Chan welcomes you in and tells you to sit and eat.
